review_scope: Independent review of final editable geometry, portable exports, metadata, source boundaries, local semantic/kinematic behavior, and rendered pixels

checks.name: package_unit_tests
checks.detail: Independently executed against the rebuilt geometry; tests check identifiers, finite transforms, source gates, GLB/PNG structure, static state guards, and allowlist paths

checks.name: additional_semantic_guard_cases
checks.detail: Rejected handling/optics/lateral actions during contact, rejected invalid custody transitions and unknown events, verified optical revision change and false physical-calibration validity

checks.name: actual_blend_geometry_and_pose_roundtrip
checks.detail: Loaded final Blend independently; held -> docked -> held returns to the identical initial arm poses, preserving each 21 mm authored pivot radius

checks.name: metric_geometry_and_transform_conversion
checks.detail: Metric Blender scale=1; all 347 exported part translations match (x,y,z)->(x,z,-y) glTF conversion; finite GLB transform/accessor values and buffer bounds inspected; relevant microscopic dimensions verified in exported mesh accessors

checks.name: native_layer_attachment
checks.detail: Corrected native PDMS/Al/cone stack aligns within less than 9 nm stored-float tolerance; this checks authored mesh placement, not fabrication or optical qualification

checks.name: distinct_optical_configurations
checks.detail: Parallel Mitutoyo 10x NA 0.28 and characterization Olympus 10x with unknown NA remain distinct in metadata, scene roots, labels, and semantic configuration IDs

checks.name: source_vs_authored_dimensions
checks.detail: Conical dimensions remain SI numerical-model parameters; cylinder dimensions remain reported physical preparation values. Subset layout, radius allocation, apparatus, carriers, target motifs, display slabs and exploded offsets are explicitly authored

checks.name: unresolved_source_scale
checks.detail: 0.5 mm versus 5 mm discrepancy remains unresolved; whole-array span is null and 1088-position allocation is not supplied

checks.name: embedded_resource_and_public_payload_review
checks.detail: No external Blend libraries or raster files, no GLB images/textures/external URIs; built-in Bfont only. Explicit publication allowlist excludes raw papers/source archives, logs and Blend backups. Final ZIP construction and manifest consistency are separate release-stage checks

checks.name: actual_rendered_pixels
checks.detail: All three final 1600x1100 PNGs inspected visually: distinct apparatus placement, labeled layer/cylinder detail, carrier/grasp proxy and XYZ datum are visible

resolved_findings: Clamp pose now orbits its visible pivot
Inventory evaluated before recording rotated text bounds
Empty explainer roots removed from apparatus export
Initial-state affordance-frame validity, authored clamp limits and unimplemented connector details disclosed

nonblocking_findings.detail: Fine scale/hold captions in the microassembly render are small and low contrast. README and dimension metadata remain authoritative; higher-contrast captions would improve standalone image readability

limitations: Static authored approximation only; no manufacturer dimensional certification, optical alignment, working-distance validation or full experimental-array reconstruction
No physical simulation, calibrated material/contact behavior, collision validation, force sensing, real device execution or robot reachability
Toy semantic guards and kinematic pose changes are not physical release, custody, calibration or safety evidence
Carrier/fixture tolerances, gripper suitability, retained support and collision-free insertion remain unqualified; fixed affordance world poses require recomputation after pose changes
No scientific reproduction, target metrology or source-conflict resolution; microscopic materials and optical appearances are visual approximations
archive_status: Archive not yet constructed at review-writing time; release owner must verify exact allowlist and manifest hashes after packaging
